## About Me

I am a final-year Master's student in Bioinformatics, currently completing my end-of-studies internship at the Centre d'Anthropobiologie et de Génomique de Toulouse (CAGT). I specialize in genomic data analysis and the design of highly reproducible workflows.

I am actively seeking a position (Fixed-term, Permanent, or Research Engineer) in the **Montpellier and Sète area** starting in **September 2026**. I have a strong background in building robust architectures for evolutionary analysis, population genomics, and structural modeling.

## Core Competencies
* **Pipelines & Reproducibility:** Snakemake, Git/GitHub workflows
* **Genomics & Bioinformatics:** GLIMPSE2, ANGSD, GROMACS
* **Programming & Systems:** Python (NumPy, Pandas), R, Advanced Linux Administration
